turns.instruction:
Use OpenSees to analyze the symmetric pitched-roof portal frame: span 20 m, eaves height 6 m and ridge P=(10,0,8) m. Both bases are fixed and the eaves and ridge joints are rigid. In load case D, apply global downward 6 kN/m separately to both inclined roof members, measured per metre of actual sloping member length. Report ux and uz at the ridge P and both eaves L/R, all six local section-force components N/V2/V3/T/M2/M3 immediately inside both ends of both inclined roof members SL/SR, and Fx/Fz/My at each fixed base A/B. Keep the distributed loads vertical in global axes. Use the complete attached node, member, property and load tables. Use first-order linear-elastic static analysis with self-weight, P-Delta, rigid diaphragms and rigid offsets disabled. State the load case, location, component, sign and unit for every result: m for displacements, kN for forces and kN.m for moments. Preserve the actual OpenSees version, runnable input, execution log and raw results, and check global equilibrium.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
